picks.title: ‘Spotify is now an agent’ – Co-CEO outlines company’s AI plan
picks.rationale: New strategy statement: Spotify's co-CEO says the service will be the music layer that personal agents (Muse, Dots, Claude Duet) call on. That is broader than the single Muse integration covered 9-27.
picks.excerpt: Following the launches of personal agents such as Meta's Muse, OpenAI's Dots and Anthropic's Claude Duet, Spotify's co-CEO laid out how the service plans to become the music layer AI agents call on.

picks.title: [단독] 'AI 음악' 저작권 신청 1년새 500% 급증…기준 미비에 전부 '미등록'
picks.rationale: New data: AI-assisted song filings at KOMCA rose from 133 to 759 in a year, and all 892 applications are still unregistered because there is no standard for human contribution. This matters to anyone releasing AI-assisted tracks in Korea.
picks.excerpt: Copyright filings for AI-assisted songs at KOMCA rose from 133 to 759 in a year, but all 892 applications remain unregistered because there is no standard for judging human creative contribution.

picks.title: AI 음악 기술 '뉴튠', 오디오비주얼 에이전트 DJ '탈' ADE 2026서 첫 공개
picks.rationale: New unveiling: Neutune showed 'Tal', an audiovisual AI agent DJ backed by KOCCA, at Amsterdam Dance Event 2026. It is an early live-performance use of agentic AI.
picks.excerpt: Korean AI music company Neutune unveiled 'Tal', an audiovisual AI agent DJ project backed by KOCCA's AI content programme, at Amsterdam Dance Event 2026.

picks.title: Controllable Mono-to-Stereo Upmixing using Reward-tilted Flows
picks.rationale: New research: a flow-matching upmixer turns mono recordings into realistic stereo, and reward tilting lets the engineer steer the stereo image. Directly useful for restoration and remix work.
picks.excerpt: A flow-matching upmixer that generates realistic stereo from single-channel recordings, with reward tilting to give engineers control over the resulting stereo image.

picks.title: FLOMSS: Generative Music Source Separation by Flow Matching
picks.rationale: New research: a systematic study of flow matching as a generative alternative to the discriminative separators behind today's stem splitters, run on full-band four-stem audio. The model is the whole story, and it points to where stem-splitting tools could go next.
picks.excerpt: A systematic study of flow matching as a generative approach to four-stem music source separation (vocals, bass, drums, other) on full-band audio, an alternative to the discriminative separators behind today's stem splitters.
